title: algerian mutton tagine recipe
description: a hearty, umami-rich stew made with tender mutton, sweet potatoes, and a hint of char-grill-yang, perfect for breaking fasts and hangovers alike.
instructions: heat olive oil in a large clay pot or heavy-based pan over medium heat.
add chopped onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened and lightly browned, about 10 minutes.
add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
add lamb shoulder or neck and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
add canned diced tomatoes, sweet potatoes, and 200ml of soy milk.
season with salt, black pepper, and a pinch of cayenne pepper (if using).
cover the pot and bring the mixture to a boil.
reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 hours or until the lamb is tender and the stew has thickened.
taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
